title: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
hook_before: Google just released an experimental app called Google AI Edge Foresight.
script:
Google's new experimental app runs entirely offline.
It transcribes your meetings entirely offline on macOS.
The free tool runs on the on-device EmbeddingGemma two model.
Your audio never leaves your laptop.
Would you trust an offline app with your meetings?
